item.title: State High RB D’Antae Sheffey Commits to Penn State
item.description: Penn State has added a local prospect to its 2026 recruiting class. Three-star running back D'Antae Sheffey has committed to the Nittany Lions, he announced on social media Wednesday night. He's a current senior at State College Area High School, where he totaled 234 carries for 1,613 yards and 24 touchdowns this past season, all career bests. item.title: Moshannon Valley Economic Development Partnership Names Josiah Jones Executive Director
item.description: The Moshannon Valley Economic Development Partnership has named Josiah Jones as its new executive director, the Philipsburg-based nonprofit organization announced this week. item.title: Persian Restaurant to Open in Former Kimchi Location
item.description: A new Persian restaurant is coming to the former location of a recently closed Korean eatery in Ferguson Township. Fire & Fig Grill is getting ready to open at 1100 N. item.title: Report: Penn State to Hire Savon Huggins as Running Backs Coach
item.description: Matt Campbell has reportedly filled the final coordinator spot on his staff. Penn State is set to hire running backs coach Savon Huggins, according to a report by 247Sports' Matt Zenitz. Huggins spent the previous five seasons at Boston College, including the last four as running backs coach, with mixed results.
